quote.text: Where do I keep everyone's allergies and reactions

promise.text: What to put in a family medical binder

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "allerg", "reaction"

lines.text: Keep one dated health summary per person, with current medicines, allergies, contacts and record locations.
Share only the pages each reader needs.

items.text: Ask each adult what information they want help keeping and who may see it.
Start with current safety-relevant facts and contacts, not the entire history.
Collect the medication information and mark any disagreement for pharmacist or prescriber review.
Request missing official records rather than recreating vaccination dates or test results from memory.
Write where the source documents live and how an authorized helper can obtain them.
Choose one master, a backup and a replacement process for handed-out copies.

line.text: Per person, with what happens recorded alongside, in one place you can reach without a clinic portal login.
